system.description:
A swifter, deadlier turn on Earth Control: you drop into the ground and burst up an instant later at your foe's flank, striking before he knows you have moved.

Prerequisite: Elder Protean (Earth Control). Spend two Blood Traits to sink into the ground and instantly resurface behind or beside a target in your line of sight (never directly beneath a person); if you linger underground instead, you are simply using Earth Control. You gain an automatic Surprise attack against that opponent regardless of any Celerity, Auspex or other speed- or perception-related power he may possess, and the target defends against your attack at a three-Trait penalty.
